questions.q: What order do a notice's header elements follow?
questions.a: Institution name → NOTICE → date → heading. A wrong answer leading with the heading treats the notice like an essay title — authority leads the format.

questions.q: Which body sentence is notice-legal: 'You should all come and have fun!' or 'Interested students may register with the undersigned by 8 May'?
questions.a: The second — third person, action + deadline + contact. The first is invitation-register with first/second person — notices inform, never invite.

questions.q: A notice is 70 words including 'a very exciting and wonderful celebration' — first cut?
questions.a: The enthusiasm-phrase — adjectives performing excitement are the first fat to trim. The 4W facts are untouchable; decoration is expendable.

questions.a: The student drafts a compliant notice with all elements, third-person clipped body, and under-limit word count, and audits defective notices for register and skeleton faults.
